decisions.reason: As an agency-focused compliance tool with at least some positive market feedback and clear fit with the firm's stated expansion in compliance capabilities, it is likely kept while management uses available slack to learn more before judging it below aspiration.

Because the platform builds directly on the core hosting business and is prominent on the home page, management would likely see it as strategically central and well worth retaining unless results fall far below aspiration.

A configurable managed hosting plan is close to the established offer and likely supports existing customers, so in a growing market the firm would usually keep it unless early uptake clearly underperforms comparable products.
